description: This file contains a function 'smarty_core_get_include_path' that retrieves the include path for a given file, used internally within Smarty plugin system to locate template files in the include path.

methods.name: smarty_core_get_include_path
methods.description: Retrieves the full file path by searching in the PHP include_path, split by ';' or ':' depending on the OS, and sets the 'new_file_path' parameter if found.
